cards.review_notes: The school partnership announcement was found in an official search result for the former camp URL, although the supplied current page is the homepage. It states four weeklong sessions in June and July 2026; individual dates and prices were not exposed in readable official pages. Check Wortham's session images or registration listings. The venue publishes 18 Biltmore Avenue as its address, but the camp FAQ directs drop-off and pickup to the rear on S. Market Street between Court Plaza and Eagle Street. The summer page still says registration is open; availability is left null because that wording refers to the past 2026 season.
